message.reasoning_content:
need to determine appropriate crime labels based on facts.

Facts: Bear (熊某) and others abducted Chen (陈某), detained, beat, extorted money (30,000 RMB) and demanded gun and armor, also took necklace as collateral. They used weapons, forced victim to pay. This seems to be kidnapping (illegal detention) and extortion (maybe robbery?).

We have correction lessons: For illegal detention, label is 【非法拘禁】 (not combined with intentional injury unless injury meets criteria). Here there is also assault causing light injury. The correction says: illegal detention only, not intentional injury if injury is light and considered subordinate. So label should be 非法拘禁.

Also there is extortion: they forced victim to give money under threat of violence. The crime is "敲诈勒索" (extortion). In Chinese criminal law, extortion is called "敲诈勒索罪". The facts: they used threats and violence to obtain money. So we need label 【敲诈勒索】.

But we must check if there is also "非法持有枪支" etc. They used guns? They had a gun, but they didn't illegally possess? They used a gun belonging to victim. Not necessarily a crime of illegal possession.

Also "抢夺" not, because they didn't take property by force in public; they abducted and extorted.

Thus likely two charges: 非法拘禁; 敲诈勒索.

Check correction lessons: There's a rule about "非法拘禁" (not combined with intentional injury). So we should label only illegal detention, not intentional injury.

Also there is "敲诈勒索" separate.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法拘禁;敲诈勒索<eoa>
